We're cowering in the face of voter suppression, and we refuse to give up the fight to increase voter participation across the country. We're focusing all our energy on registering and turning out every voter we can .
Driving voter participation is more critical now than ever. RUSH $30 or more today and help register new and lapsed voters across the country >> [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/ifvap-voterregistration?refcode=052026_3&amount=30]
Voter Action Project [https://voteractionproject.org/]
How did Americans across the country, especially in the South, respond to the Supreme Court's decision to legally codify racial gerrymandering? They turned out in droves to march for their fundamental right to vote, folks.
For those of us who couldn't make it to Selma, Montgomery, or other places to march? We have to do everything we can to register a tidal wave of voters across the country.
Voter registration is a critical part of grassroots efforts to protect voting rights. The more people who vote, the more our government looks like we, the people. But to get to the point where every voice is heard, we need your help .
Every $3 chipped in can help us register a new voter. If you're with us in this fight, please pitch in $30 or whatever you can today to help register 10 new voters >> [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/ifvap-voterregistration?refcode=052026_3&amount=30]
If you've saved your payment information with ActBlue Express, your donation will go through immediately:
GIVE $15 NOW ➜ [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/ifvap-voterregistration?express_lane=true&refcode=052026_3&amount=15] GIVE $25 NOW ➜ [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/ifvap-voterregistration?express_lane=true&refcode=052026_3&amount=25] GIVE $50 NOW ➜ [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/ifvap-voterregistration?express_lane=true&refcode=052026_3&amount=50]
GIVE $100 NOW ➜ [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/ifvap-voterregistration?express_lane=true&refcode=052026_3&amount=100] GIVE $250 NOW ➜ [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/ifvap-voterregistration?express_lane=true&refcode=052026_3&amount=250] OTHER AMOUNT [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/ifvap-voterregistration?refcode=052026_3&amount=36]
This was a devastating blow to voting rights, but it only serves to strengthen our resolve. If anti-voting forces are going to stack the deck against the communities we serve, then we will work even harder to engage and rally these voters, lift their voices, and defend their right to vote.
Despite vote-suppressing courts and state legislatures making it harder to register to vote -- passing bills to stop organizations like ours and our partners on the ground from helping potential voters navigate the increasingly murky rules around voter registration -- we're still pulling out all the stops to bring voters into the system.
Voter participation has been increasing. Voting quickly becomes a habit -- a habit our democracy sorely needs to fulfill the promise of the American dream. Overwhelming key states with new voter registrations can help turn the tide against the voter suppression laws we've seen passed the last few years.
This voter registration work, at just about $3 per new voter, is how we can make the greatest impact. Fuel our efforts with $30 to give us the resources we need to register new voters ahead of the 2026 deadlines >> [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/ifvap-voterregistration?refcode=052026_3&amount=30]
Thank you,
Voter Action Project's Registration Team
Voter Action Project [https://voteractionproject.org/]

Integrity First Voter Action Project is dedicated to expanding ballot access and increasing voter participation across the country.
Since the Supreme Court gutted key provisions in the Voting Rights Act, extreme politicians have taken advantage to pass harsh laws that restrict access to the ballot box. These restrictions particularly affect disadvantaged communities and people of color. It’s our goal to bring awareness to these laws wherever they may crop up and organize voters to take action to ensure the right to vote is available to everyone in their states and communities.
Your support is crucial to our efforts. Will you donate today to help us protect voting rights? [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/integrity-first-voter-action-project-1?refcode=052026_3&amount=20]

Trump says Iran talks are nearly done — deal now, or another strike.

|

|

Sponsored By:
[](https://email.alert.republicantaskforce.com/c/eJyc0L1uwyAUxfGnwVssuNgQBoa2kbdEkVqpo8XHtYMKtgU4fv0qfYTO5-g3_L-v49WEGJb5ZhLqXKfRr36seU8bJswzlmdwdc1h3UtY0ggUxIn2J6DjEkfWeO2dN8w1qJmUigNwJpqH9mitk0Ke7QS0RzcpzrhBa6VijsqpCfpF0R4YpYz1ohVenq2xSlroGChHOmoi5tpm3HYbgzNLNeVnWrPD1q2pifpR61YIfyMwEBiO42jn_YRuTa-dwACX7i7O6pPAwJnqb-_d68mHsltG-OXr_tFk7bcjxBiKkKSjczIh_un1HzGeGn4DAAD__3mDa_Q)
The Permanent Campaign is brought to you today in partnership with
Republican Task Force Issue: 5/20/2026
Iran: Deal or Strike

Trump declared Iran nuclear negotiations are in their “final stages” on Tuesday, warning he would authorize a new [military strike](https://email.alert.republicantaskforce.com/c/eJyckL2OozAUhZ8GOiP7AnYoXGxDl223RBf7QrzxD7JNmHn7UfIIUx4d6eh837_7ckfnXdz_YiCd67bYZJeaz3BQoLxTeTlTU3bpLC6GBThIxkcGfIl-Ea3V1lgUpiUtlJp6gF7I9qGpn6TsydhNqkFso8FeSDmuCowAceOt0-8pPoLgXIhRdtKq24rrpFYYBEymGTh6yrXLdJyrdwZjxfLcUjbUmRRarx-1HqXp_zQwNzBf19Vt6SvSVd59A7N3L2Lv3MD8QWIP9LWwgP9TZlgrmidLkbmMkZWa3ZNYPI0nzOwiPFIs7MhpzxhYwG8mpjZre1zOe1ekaga-B3T-86b-Qt5Lw08AAAD__1R0gYM) if talks collapse. Tankers began exiting the Strait of Hormuz as a precaution amid the standoff. Vice President Vance told reporters the U.S. remains “[locked and loaded](https://email.alert.republicantaskforce.com/c/eJyckLuOqzAURb8GOiPbPAyFi9vQ5bZTosOxIWfiB7JNmPz9KPmEqbe0tdb6ui03IEdh_w_e6lS2xUSzlHT6w3qbdpufhCUmimem4BfJ5cB4zyRfgltEbbRBAwJrq4VSUytlK4b6rrEToNZ2RN6Pa2eUAhwHFJKv7TRNltek31e8l4JzIfqhGYwaV1gntcpOyAmrjoOzqTTJHufqCCEUyI8tJrQNRl87fS_lyFX7r5JzJefrupot_gR75fdeyfmIjgphruT8bdgTAlqW4ZXZx4-5iA9rmItgrGHJ5gKpME-OCqQXQ_AH0B4YJQgsnOgsJFbAPTLbgFydtDkuco7yoKqO7x7IfcjKH0I-tfwNAAD__wh6hsw)” to restart the military campaign against Iran if diplomacy stalls. Tehran’s delegation has pressed for U.S. troop withdrawals and war reparations as preconditions for any deal. Trump revealed he had come [within an hour](https://email.alert.republicantaskforce.com/c/eJyckLGuozAQRb_GdBPZEwJLQbEN3dt2SzTYA4yesZE9Cdq_XyWf8Pqre-85f7_mL5IoaftDB49F1znkMGt5HicfXDauL_Gai-RnlXTMaLED-wC0c4qza8IYfCDnGx5d3w93xLvrmn0k79mtlkLAlVrvlnZYMAzO9ysPwYdGxneVfaCz1rlHd-tC_2uhZegXbB0O3rSWIhe9FT6fSxRPSal-r7l4vvl8NHHcVc9q7r8NTgan67puS2HRhYq-EwanM0dR8dXg9J4zONmHwckNBqcPJBR-McUKO8NFFSjBnp8F6KJ_sJZ8gBRKULXIN4PuhUk5VVhkg10UZIXEW1YhlZwqrCTR4NSUMZyXxCi1601rt4Mkfl7rDyS_RvwfAAD__y6Ij0I) of ordering a strike on Iran’s nuclear weapons program before the ceasefire pause began. Israel’s military has maintained high alert throughout the negotiations. ★★★
Senate Rebukes Trump on Iran

The Senate passed a War Powers Resolution directing President Trump to end military operations in Iran by a [50–47 vote](https://email.alert.republicantaskforce.com/c/eJyckDuOpDAUAE8DmZFtwDSBg03IetMNkXl-0E_rn2zTnuOPeo4wcUmlUv177k9DjsL113jUuZ67jXav-fYJPeYLy5ugxkzxLhT8LrlUjM9M8j24XfRWW7BGQI9aLMs6SjkK1b-0eoCYABauVnMgLMqqE6RSdpwRRoE96Y-Kz1JwLsSsBmWXx2GOdTnkJOQK3cSNw1yHjOk-HIEJ1ZT_Z8yAA0TfO_2qNZVu_NPJrZNba20441fAVj68k1uKjipB6eRm0RdWIGZkjQK7YmIFg6kxsxe6VJixbxMAGWUTWDOZpdgwF5axRHdXiqHP2qZGzlFRSzfxyxtyPyX1F-PeWn4HAAD__1PpgYY)—the first direct congressional rebuke of the president’s Iran campaign. Sen. Bill Cassidy, R-Louisiana, provided the decisive vote, breaking with his party just one week after [losing his Senate primary](https://email.alert.republicantaskforce.com/c/eJyc0LuO4yAUxvGnsTsiOOFiFxTbuMu2W1qHi-OjBWMBiTVvP8o8wtTfp1_x__dYH0iJjudfzNHWvq2hhLXXVz5jjvUZ25t8L5XKq9GRV-CgGVcM-HqkVYzBBh9Q-DFaYcx8B7gLPe4WlVFy47BNM6DyUTg5aYcBvRZik2Yk-6G4AsG5EErfdDCTQzcbB1LA7AfJMcXabzWeL5fI49Gx_d9K9fHmSx6T3Xs_23D_M8AywNL3uFNKn22AZS85HvFqAyxqmjQHyRylxDy2RuGLUcWDXVjZWa5YP7ex2nBelBI1bQbJnxnpRxv7L8K8LXwHAAD__22lcsE) to a Trump-backed challenger. He was the fourth Republican to support the measure. The resolution still needs House passage to reach Trump’s desk, and the White House has [opposed legislative limits](https://email.alert.republicantaskforce.com/c/eJyckLGOszAQhJ_GdET2YjAULv6GLn97JVrsDVmdsZHthLu3PyXFPcC1o9Fovu_julyRA8ftP-5kc70tPvml5sd-0E55o_JkV1Pm9Cgc9wUkDK3sW5BLDItqvPXOo3INWWXM1AF0amjudtJ6NKMZvRxIGaTbRBp0Z6iTiHIdGravKdmDklKpfrgM3owrrpNZQSuYnNASA-V6yXQ81sAOY8XyeUvZ0cWlvQn2XutRRPdPwCxgPrHcOW41RfrCnSPlV03AHOksAuZCESsJmHVv-r7rf6OWM8b2zdyemNsjnZRL67AU9t9Ntv44OQQugxFabjtyeB-of_D1tPATAAD__ycOe3w) on its military operations against Iran. An override would require a two-thirds majority in both chambers—a threshold far beyond the 50–47 margin on Tuesday. ★★★
Trump Orders Banks: Check Citizenship

President Trump signed an executive order on Tuesday directing financial regulators to guide banks on verifying[ customers’ citizenship status](https://email.alert.republicantaskforce.com/c/eJyckLuOpDAURL_GZG7Zl8aYwMEmZLPphsgv4Gr8QPZlRtqvX3XvH0xcqjqq8-dj-7CYsBy_bY6m0b6FGjZqd75iju2I_Qs91Yb17ljyBgIUFxMHsZW0ySGY4IOVfohGzvMyAoxSDaexQstFC6EmtctZ-6ikHJ2WAtw-6t0NaF5TYgIphJSTeqgwa2fdMjt4Slg8ewqbYqNHi9ftEnpbyPbPvTYfH77mIZmT6Ops_MVgZbDSGU9M6ZUxWM-aY4nfncFqQ8aCnZolrIXBOmmtFlA81GJT4O-33Nny2blHwr-x9BMv3snS3TnmjMf_Lo_lzc-xEIN1aCZc35gSdjWzpziyxTd_oB-o_DLwLwAA___niYX-), marking the first formal extension of immigration enforcement into the private banking sector. The order, titled [“Restoring Integrity to America’s Financial System,”](https://email.alert.republicantaskforce.com/c/eJyc0D2PnjAQBOBfYzoj23y9FC7S0F3alGixF9jEH8heXnT_Prrr0qYeaWb0_PpYP4ACpeMnRLSF99Vnv3K544URy4H1TY5zoXxXSnE1yoxSDdKoNYVVN95650G7Bq2eprkzptNjc9quV3qY-93h5FUH4zTorncvUDhvw_waG7JfVWowWimth7Ed_fTaYJunzfTazE70CgIWbgte9xbIQWKof_ZcHLYuxybYk_mqovshzCLM8jxP-5zEeOa7YnvktzDLDo5lPRG5CrN8TQqzqOGfRF4FK3lMLH1OELz8Lb8FZMHKuWCVlBiPQvwpOUuIWMhBlTslSI4gyPpZGaMwS1Osvx4Kgeo4iV4dESh83-X_0H1b8zcAAP__umWMOA) takes aim at non-citizens who use Individual Taxpayer Identification Numbers to access U.S. banking services. ITIN holders—non-citizens who lack Social Security numbers—are identified as the primary target population. The White House framed the order as a measure to combat [illicit financial activity](https://email.alert.republicantaskforce.com/c/eJyckDmOrDAQhk9jMpBdbE3g4CVk_dIJkbGroTRekF006tuPmCPMAf7l-76ey9OQp7j9NwF15tfikls4n-HAgHnD8ibLKVM6C8WwgIShln0Ncol-UZXTzjqjbIVajePUArRqqHbdtdA_zNqtE47to2-nDqAfhs6q1YEcbUX6rpI9KCmV6odmcONjNes0rtApmKzopPGYucl4nKsnayKb8v1K2WJjU6i83pmPItp_AmYB83VdzbUT457Ogs2W3gLmI2Mhh5HJ-NpYphSLgPneFjDLXsCcsdyAcaspMm6Z-FNzqk3ATNaU-kXRRHvny6cwBgFzlbU7LvKeyjCKTm7BkP89xX9w-NbwEwAA___fwYKM) and money laundering by non-citizens. Financial regulators will be tasked with developing compliance guidance for banks on how to screen account holders’ immigration status.
* * *

No one understands that better than me.
| **__A Letter from the Desk of Rep. Elise Stefanik__**
---
Peter,
---
President Trump has made it clear that he’ll do whatever it takes to WIN the midterms because he knows how vital our House Majority is to passing the America First agenda: _**“We must keep the Majority _at_ _all_ _costs_.”**_
---
No one understands that better than me.
---
Last year, I did what our country needed and withdrew my nomination to serve in President Trump’s cabinet to remain in the House and _protect_ our razor-thin Majority.
---
_And thank God I did. My vote was ultimately the tie-breaking vote to pass the President’s Big Beautiful Bill and grant tax cuts to millions of American families!_
---
For me, America First was never just a campaign slogan.
---
For every remaining minute that I have the honor to serve you in Congress, doing what’s right for our country will _**always**_ be my top priority.
---
**That’s why, even though I’m no longer running for reelection, I’m still committed to doing everything I can to help the President DEFEND his Majority.**
---
_Since I no longer need funds for my own campaign, I’ve decided the most effective way I can help is to use my grassroots donor network –**among the most powerful in the entire country** – to help America First Republicans WIN the key battleground races of the midterms. _
---
_After all the sacrifices I’ve made for our House Majority, you can rest assured that I’m going to spend every second I have left in Congress fighting to stop the Democrats from seizing control and DESTROYING everything we’ve fought so hard to accomplish._
---
But as we approach yet another critical fundraising deadline, I have no choice but to ask dedicated America First patriots like YOU to join me.
---

---
_You're getting this message because you’ve supported good causes and Democratic candidates. We need your support to continue fighting for our democracy. We love having you in our network, but if you only want our most important email updates,[click here.](https://act.blueampaction.com/go/108?t=2&akid=2300%2E259176%2ECYZ-3Q) If you'd like to unsubscribe, [click here.](https://act.blueampaction.com/go/109?t=3&akid=2300%2E259176%2ECYZ-3Q)_

We need to call this what it is: **this new map is a political lynching** — an affront to justice and the fight for equality. My heart aches for my hometown of Memphis, where I was born and raised and where generations of my family are buried. Don't give up hope, Peter.** The fight still carries on, renewed with urgency as we work to restore the rights that our ancestors marched, prayed, bled, and died for. [**This righteous fight for our rights has never been more important, to push back against Jim Crow 2.0, to end the corruption that runs rampant and free, to give Black and Brown People a true voice in their democracy. Our fight continues: Will you please split a donation of $10 right away between me and Blue Amp Action to stand against authoritarianism?**](https://act.blueampaction.com/go/12653?source=LOC_EM_FR_2026.05.20_Pearson-Gerrymander_B5_F1_S3_C3_90AC-365DON_N-T0&t=5&akid=2300%2E259176%2ECYZ-3Q) | [CONTRIBUTE $10](https://act.blueampaction.com/go/12654?source=LOC_EM_FR_2026.05.20_Pearson-Gerrymander_B5_F1_S3_C3_90AC-365DON_N-T0&t=6&akid=2300%2E259176%2ECYZ-3Q)

I hope that by the end of President Trump's administration and the beginning of the next Republican administration in 2028, we see zero military aid flowing from the United States to Israel.

The current 10-year U.S. military aid package to Israel, negotiated under the Obama administration in 2016, totals $38 billion and runs from fiscal year 2019 through fiscal year 2028. That comes out to roughly $3.8 billion annually.
For years, supporters of U.S. aid to Israel have correctly argued that much of that money returns to the United States through defense contracts, American jobs, weapons manufacturing, technology, pharmaceuticals, and joint security cooperation. Netanyahu himself has noted that most of the aid effectively comes back to America in the form of jobs and economic stimulus. This is true, and the ROI America receives from investing in Israel is enormous.
[Upgrade to paid](https://substack..sUcaZIMjT1IEtkTS6Y-o4m037OI-39nPYPjX782KDFA?&utm_medium=email&utm_source=subscribe-widget&utm_content=198637013)
But Israel's sovereignty is also at stake. Military aid creates golden handcuffs for Israel. It gives American officials leverage to tell Israel how to fight, when to stop fighting, who it is allowed to target, how it should respond to Iran, whether it can fully eradicate Hamas, whether it can neutralize Hezbollah, and whether it can destroy the Iranian nuclear threat before it is too late.
America First means we stop dictating to a sovereign nation how to run its government, its military, and its national defense. Israel should be able to bomb Iran's nuclear facilities and eliminate terrorist leaders without U.S. interference.
Once U.S. military aid to Israel ends, the Pentagon's leash comes off. Israel's wars become Israel's wars. Their foreign policy decisions become their own. And the United States will no longer have the same financial mechanism it has repeatedly used to restrain Israel from taking the military actions necessary to guarantee its survival.
Recently, I [told](https://substack.com/redirect/af2362bf-44ff-4105-8e07-1de8ec058a2e?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) _The New York Times_ :
> _" I don't foresee the G.O.P. being as explicitly pro-Israel anymore. Whether the criticism is legitimate or not, or whether it's foreign funded or not, it's there. And perception is reality."_
I also said of the growing anti-Israel hysteria on the Right,_ "It's like a psychosis. It's literally a psychosis. It really is Israel derangement syndrome."_
That is the truth. While most conservatives still support Israel, fringe elements inside the Republican Party have become obsessed with attacking the Jewish state. They sound almost identical to the radical Left. They blame Israel for everything. They pretend Iran is not a threat. They ignore Hamas, Hezbollah, the Houthis, and the Islamic Republic's decades-long war against civilization.
But let's be clear. The divide inside the GOP does not even come close to the Jew-hatred and anti-Israel fanaticism that has infected the Democrat Party. Democrats march with Hamas sympathizers, call Israel an apartheid state, and demand arms embargoes against Israel while Islamic terrorists hold hostages and fire rockets at civilians. Democrats have turned anti-Israel activism into a central plank of their activist base. That is why Israel cannot allow its future to depend on American elections.
Israel cannot allow its survival to depend on whether Democrats win the White House, whether isolationists dominate the GOP, or whether online influencers decide that attacking Israel gets them more engagement and larger X payouts.
While in Israel, I visited the edge of Israel's borders with Gaza and Syria. I met survivors of the October 7 Islamic terrorist ambush who defended their kibbutz from Hamas terrorists. I met members of the IDF struggling with PTSD. I met the parents of children murdered by Hezbollah rocket attacks in the Golan Heights. I met members of the Knesset. I met family members of Druze victims of Abu Mohammed Al-Julani's violence against religious minorities in Syria.
My biggest takeaway was that Israel must become fully sovereign to guarantee its security, and the only way to do that is by ending all U.S. aid to Israel.
We cannot claim "America First" while underwriting another country's military and then allowing our own roads, border wall, election integrity systems, veterans services, and domestic infrastructure to fall apart.
[Upgrade to paid](https://substack..sUcaZIMjT1IEtkTS6Y-o4m037OI-39nPYPjX782KDFA?&utm_medium=email&utm_source=subscribe-widget&utm_content=198637013)
At the same time, we cannot pretend Israel is some helpless client state. Israel is a powerful, advanced, technologically sophisticated nation with one of the strongest militaries in the world. It can and should stand on its own. Cutting aid would also remove the favorite talking point of the anti-Israel Right and the antisemitic Left.
In the past, I supported U.S. aid to Israel because I believed Israel's security and America's security were inseparable. But the politics of the issue have changed. If Israel remains overly reliant on U.S. military aid, it will be restrained by the same American bureaucracy that has repeatedly empowered Iran, appeased terrorists, funded bad actors, and lectured Israel while Israeli civilians and American citizens are murdered by jihadists.
Netanyahu understands that Israel must prepare for a future where American support is no longer guaranteed. He understands that the current aid package expires in 2028. He understands that if Democrats recapture power in Washington, the drawdown may need to happen much faster than anyone expected. He knows that the best way to preserve the U.S.-Israel alliance is to make it an alliance of two strong, sovereign nations, not a relationship built on [financial dependency](https://substack.com/redirect/05e97bf3-9e6e-42e0-9b7b-7b872b85acbd?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) and political leverage.
If you truly believe Israel has a right to exist as a sovereign state, then you should support ending all U.S. military aid to Israel.

Rep. Scott DesJarlais has been in Washington for 14 years... and somewhere along the way, something shifted.
He stopped working for the people of Tennessee's 4th District and started working for the people who keep him in power; the lobbyists, the corporate donors, and the insiders who have rigged this system in their favor for decades. **THE NUMBERS DON 'T LIE:**
| [](https://link.sbstck.com/redirect/f6b8c673-d2eb-4845-9793-ea953ac05ed5?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
**The GOP is bankrolling this race because they know we are coming.** 47.1% of my opponent's funds come from PACs... meaning he is answering to a whole lot of groups that ARE NOT YOU.
**[Can I count on you to chip in $15 to a campaign fueled by Americans, for Americans, built and ran by Americans?](https://link.sbstck.com/redirect/1474c302-728f-4816-8c6d-5295c4d8d2c3?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)**
[ PITCH IN TODAY!!️](https://link.sbstck.com/redirect/1474c302-728f-4816-8c6d-5295c4d8d2c3?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
Listen, the shift didn't happen overnight. The fundraisers replace the town halls. The donor calls replace the constituent calls and before long, they're not your representative anymore. They're Washington's man in Tennessee.
That's Scott DesJarlais today. While working families in this district are juggling two jobs just to cover rent, while small business owners are drowning in costs they can't control, while families are wondering if they'll ever get ahead, **DesJarlais is protecting the interests of the people who write him checks.**
I'm Mike Cortese, and I know what it looks like to start with nothing. I arrived in Nashville in 2001 with no car, no computer, and no connections. My wife and I built our lives from the ground up. I know what this district needs because I've lived it.
| [](https://link.sbstck.com/redirect/99acbbe6-2e7f-416a-a4a9-3582cccc8cb3?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|

This government should belong to working people again, not career politicians who have forgotten who sent them there.

Help us reach thousands of working people!

| | **Kshama Sawant is the ONLY candidate running in Washington's Ninth Congressional District with a proven track record of fighting and winning for working people!**
That's why the Democratic and Republican parties will fight tooth and nail to keep her out of Congress. And that’s why we’re building a **mass grassroots campaign to talk to tens of thousands of working people** about the importance of winning this historic race!
---
|
---
| | **JOIN US FOR OUR MAY VOLUNTEER DAY**[**THIS SATURDAY, MAY 23rd AT 11:00AM**](https://us.list-manage.com/wE0j4Da6hGx?e=bbdb764b3a&c2id=8b3f9b08d69d5a7a0bcc2cd67f268e15)
[ RSVP for one of these meetup locations:](https://us.list-manage.com/j0DmB6YlC4g?e=bbdb764b3a&c2id=8b3f9b08d69d5a7a0bcc2cd67f268e15)Seattle, Columbia City - Columbia Park Renton Downtown - Jones Park
---

---
| | **Not in Seattle, or can't make it to Volunteer Day?**[**DONATE**](https://us.list-manage.com/Y5cp8wt3Hh0?e=bbdb764b3a&c2id=8b3f9b08d69d5a7a0bcc2cd67f268e15)**or sign up for another**[**volunteer event!**](https://us.list-manage.com/zhwRAGjycTv?e=bbdb764b3a&c2id=8b3f9b08d69d5a7a0bcc2cd67f268e15)
[**Can you donate $25, $100, or $500 now?**](https://us.list-manage.com/wUoUKBoSlyC?e=bbdb764b3a&c2id=8b3f9b08d69d5a7a0bcc2cd67f268e15)
---
| | Dear Peter,
**As you may already know, Kshama Sawant** is [on the ballot](https://us.list-manage.com/135BKmVJ95o?e=bbdb764b3a&c2id=8b3f9b08d69d5a7a0bcc2cd67f268e15) and the primary election is underway! There are less than three months until election night and we need you to help us spread the word about why **electing a proven fighter like Kshama to Congress would be a historic breakthrough for working people!**
**JOIN US** for May Volunteer Day this **Saturday, May 23 at 11am!** We will have two simultaneous meetups at different locations in the district before heading out to many different spots to talk to working people about Kshama's campaign. Join us at whichever location workers best for you:
* [Columbia Park ](https://us.list-manage.com/RX9hDAIIqVT?e=bbdb764b3a&c2id=8b3f9b08d69d5a7a0bcc2cd67f268e15)in Seattle, next to the PCC in Columbia City
* [Jones Park](https://us.list-manage.com/8BupXc5POjA?e=bbdb764b3a&c2id=8b3f9b08d69d5a7a0bcc2cd67f268e15) in Downtown Renton

Please [sign up](https://us.list-manage.com/v320JTOLbZE?e=bbdb764b3a&c2id=8b3f9b08d69d5a7a0bcc2cd67f268e15) and indicate which location. We will hold a training about how to talk to working people about this campaign and get them active in this fight to elect Kshama as the first-ever revolutionary socialist to Congress. We’ll hold a short rally at each location, followed by tabling and postering to get the word out to thousands of working people about **Kshama Sawant’s independent socialist, antiwar, pro-worker campaign for Congress!**
Kshama has an unparalleled track record of winning victories for working people—like the **highest minimum wage** in the nation, the **Amazon Tax** that taxes the wealthiest businesses hundreds of millions of dollars annually to fund affordable housing, and **landmark renters’ rights** victories.
We know that big corporations and the weapons industry will spend millions to try to stop us, and it will take **an army of working class volunteers to elect Kshama to Congress!** This is your chance to get involved in the most exciting and groundbreaking campaign in the country. Whether it’s your **first time canvassing or you are a frequent volunteer** , please come out on Saturday to learn how we fight and put it into action! Snacks and water will be provided.
We’ll talk to people about how **Kshama will take the same movement-based, fighting approach in Congress as she did in Seattle** , and about the demands of our campaign:
* Free Healthcare for All — Tax the Rich
* Shut Down ICE and the Detention Centers — Stop the Deportations
* End all Military Aid to Israel — End the Genocide and Occupation of Gaza
* Stop the Data Centers and AI Layoffs — Bring Big Tech & Energy Corporations into Democratic Public Ownership
* National Rent Control & Build Millions of Affordable Homes

The incumbent in this race, Democratic Congressman Adam Smith, never met a war he didn’t like. Despite his recent rhetoric, Smith voted in December for over $906 billion for military spending, essentially writing a blank check for Trump’s wars! Adam Smith has received over $1.3 million from pro-genocide, Zionist organizations like AIPAC, and millions more will flow from the billionaires and big corporations, including the war industry. We need every volunteer and every penny to fight back against these powerful interests.
We have defeated the rich and their political servants many times before with Kshama’s leadership during her decade as the only socialist on the Seattle City Council. She has led movements of thousands of working people to victory. We have a chance once again to lead the way and hand a historic defeat to the billionaires and their political servants.
**There are still thousands of people who don’t know about this campaign and we need your help to reach them!**
See you on Saturday at 11am!
Solidarity,Kshama for Congress

name: Danielle Bethell for Governor
subject: Thank You
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Friends of Danielle Bethell PAC 20220 [Preferences](https://daniellebethell
body:
Because of you, we built something real.
[](https://daniellebethell.cmail20.com/t/y-l-aujcjl-hhlrhljhit-r/) Friends,Today, more than anything else, I want to say thank you.When I decided to run for Governor, I knew it would be an uphill fight. I wasn't the former statewide nominee. I wasn't the former NBA player. I wasn't the candidate who could write themself a big check or one with political infrastructure already built.I was a Marion County Commissioner, a small business owner, a mom, and a grandmother who believed Oregon needed a different kind of leadership.And because of you, we built something real.Together, we traveled across Oregon talking honestly about the challenges facing our state: rising crime, addiction, homelessness, unaffordable living costs, struggling schools, and a government that too often feels disconnected from everyday people.But we also talked about hope. About rebuilding Oregon. About what happens when leaders stop managing decline and start fighting for the people they serve.I will never forget the people I met during this campaign. The stories, the prayers, the encouragement, the conversations in small towns and living rooms and community halls across this state meant more to me than I can properly put into words.Many of you shared deeply personal stories with me. Some of you told me you saw your own struggles reflected in mine. Others said you finally felt like someone understood what ordinary Oregonians are living through right now.That trust is something I will carry with me forever.While last night's result was not what we hoped for, I remain incredibly proud of what we built together in such a short amount of time. We proved there is a growing movement of Oregonians hungry for practical leadership, honesty, grit, and leaders who understand real life outside of political circles.I also want to congratulate Senator Christine Drazan on becoming our Republican nominee for Governor. I hope Republicans, Independents, and fed-up Democrats across Oregon will unite behind her campaign as we work to defeat Tina Kotek in November. Oregon simply cannot continue down its current path.As for me, this is not the end of caring deeply about this state or fighting for the communities I love. Public service was never about a title. It has always been about people. I'll continue serving as Marion County Commissioner and fighting for a better Oregon for us all. Thank you for believing with me.
Thank you for standing with me.
Thank you for giving this campaign your time, your energy, your prayers, and your heart.If you put up a yard sign or field sign in support of this campaign, please remember to recycle it. It was truly an honor.Danielle Bethell
Marion County Commissioner**P.S.** While this campaign has ended, my time in public service has not. I'm proud to continue serving as a Marion County Commissioner. [You can follow along here](https://daniellebethell.cmail20.com/t/y-l-aujcjl-hhlrhljhit-y/). [](https://daniellebethell.cmail20.com/t/y-l-aujcjl-hhlrhljhit-j/)[](https://daniellebethell.cmail20.com/t/y-l-aujcjl-hhlrhljhit-t/)[](https://daniellebethell.cmail20.com/t/y-l-aujcjl-hhlrhljhit-i/)[](https://daniellebethell.cmail20.com/t/y-l-aujcjl-hhlrhljhit-d/) | [ Share ](https://daniellebethell.cmail20.com/t/y-fb-aujcjl-hhlrhljhit-h/) | [ Tweet ](https://daniellebethell.cmail20.com/t/y-tw-aujcjl-hhlrhljhit-k/) | [ Share ](https://daniellebethell.cmail20.com/t/y-li-aujcjl-hhlrhljhit-x/) | [ Forward ](https://daniellebethell.forwardtomyfriend.com/y-hhlrhljhit-E19159AE-aujcjl-l-m)

Twelve straight months. ZERO illegal aliens released into our communities.

I'm proud to stand with every Border Patrol agent putting their life on the line to keep North Carolina — and this country — safe.

Congressman Tim Moore

| | |

| | Friends,
Public safety is government's most important responsibility. Prosecutors are elected to protect constitutional rights, enforce the law fairly, and keep our communities safe.
[This week, Oakland County experienced a terrible tragedy. A mother was murdered in front of her child by a suspect who had previously been convicted in Washtenaw County and was out on parole at the time of the attack.](https://jrhsf9hbb.cc.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=001jc95Qyv2bNjNRuw9n_9B_gfhylH8UOaOacc0f9AmIa9pU4PgPDLrE3W3-g6MhxmBRKiF4XkTYPaPWSoIbP6-skVSlS46fwPPW2d8fwX1e8HRj5VUE3n1WlYC5_7OwXzuCiWNHflFG0ZO78qOih5syp6eY-nb67f6ulpTwfVqIrUqT92T6Zvkz2I9QaYtSsRp-plcdn2dZnotrQsAoF4tdM_AYNsf9GRMSRE-ZyWCxdVAoNHBd5O4M7_d-iAbW8IVh5e8naIF-VpZbXM_1InbehsPWhSO700xtohDaModKOBVOBXIBkZ-kP-HQ6drAObE&c=qnJf7BHVNE5QwgAgw0i3UCr5s2v6ZGFGDaFfjX7q34t4yZBwD__2TQ==&ch=QWRjurc9lf1QxfAHbBrmTTgwXto4UXVaQzzh06L_G3KS3Bs7kV5RwA==)
Oakland County Sheriff Michael Bouchard responded bluntly: ["These prosecutors need to do their damn job."](https://jrhsf9hbb.cc.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=001jc95Qyv2bNjNRuw9n_9B_gfhylH8UOaOacc0f9AmIa9pU4PgPDLrE3W3-g6MhxmBF968wEA052z4IJ5BFWriaiLciCRxPRZly1tTzh1JXWYz594WbcDg_3wnTYscZYXRjSEVxPIEqmLFrsdk5y5-v9ZI97hTLpanbaG0z2oDEq4T9T4M2stptHSv4O9TMq26h1zYBLyQPpg7JPjOvyvsVg==&c=qnJf7BHVNE5QwgAgw0i3UCr5s2v6ZGFGDaFfjX7q34t4yZBwD__2TQ==&ch=QWRjurc9lf1QxfAHbBrmTTgwXto4UXVaQzzh06L_G3KS3Bs7kV5RwA==) He is right. When violent offenders are treated with leniency and accountability breaks down, innocent people pay the price.
This tragedy also highlights an important contrast in the race for Attorney General.
My opponent, Washtenaw County Prosecutor Eli Savit, has championed many of the same progressive criminal justice policies that have failed in cities across the country, including efforts to eliminate cash bail and reduce penalties for drug and prostitution offenses. These policies prioritize ideology over public safety and have weakened confidence in the justice system.
I believe prosecutors have a duty to protect victims, uphold truth in sentencing, and hold violent criminals accountable. That is why more than 60 prosecutors across Michigan have endorsed our campaign. They know what is at stake.
Michigan families deserve to feel safe in their communities. They deserve an Attorney General focused on enforcing the law, supporting law enforcement, protecting victims, and keeping dangerous offenders off our streets.
Thanks to your support, our campaign continues to build momentum. [A recent MIRS/Mitchell poll showed us leading 44% to 40%](https://jrhsf9hbb.cc.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=001jc95Qyv2bNjNRuw9n_9B_gfhylH8UOaOacc0f9AmIa9pU4PgPDLrE3W3-g6MhxmBv7Rb-qbfT8TBpE3JahnHiPxTXG-nZIWDenkusFrZ91MMegm1k7Su4_S5otjRhF_0dA1lC9yFL34bU40-S7B-gdIgrmPrL04ydzPkIPZzl997ZoRSMdQSZq8ArrzLvyrmk_wkdzkLuHc9_NVDeu_9Lja_-XmLO8ayZIR7grghV5Q=&c=qnJf7BHVNE5QwgAgw0i3UCr5s2v6ZGFGDaFfjX7q34t4yZBwD__2TQ==&ch=QWRjurc9lf1QxfAHbBrmTTgwXto4UXVaQzzh06L_G3KS3Bs7kV5RwA==), the largest lead held by any Republican in a statewide race. Voters are making clear they want accountability and public safety restored to the Attorney General's office.
[With your help, we can stop dangerous policies from taking hold in Michigan and ensure public safety remains the top priority.](https://jrhsf9hbb.cc.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=001jc95Qyv2bNjNRuw9n_9B_gfhylH8UOaOacc0f9AmIa9pU4PgPDLrE_mDUgGrE3ayLVcy2f8qp2lUw36uyh7E8qRB2O3fhPDGM2v9e0p0h4ZClGYCu4791aE_JmjdkM7hh7TwQpizgZZhLAq7TT995HyJXxPwHvhvDsZYfxVPWc8K6Pn2dqxrvB4g11UC4gHfPg-zcCiVu8VjEWSe5IbinhuY8W5I6eO2&c=qnJf7BHVNE5QwgAgw0i3UCr5s2v6ZGFGDaFfjX7q34t4yZBwD__2TQ==&ch=QWRjurc9lf1QxfAHbBrmTTgwXto4UXVaQzzh06L_G3KS3Bs7kV5RwA==)

| | | | | I can't stress this enough.

Byron Donalds is the only man to keep Florida **MAGA** country.

Right now, my biggest goal is to help my father's strongest allies win ahead of the midterms, and at the top of that list is Byron Donalds.

name: Doug Lloyd for MI Attorney General
subject: UPDATE: When Prosecutors Fail, Families Suffer
body:
Oakland County tragedy exposes dangerous policies
| | |
---
| | [](https://jrhsf9hbb.cc.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=001AIGNOmnSmKnQxOonMI6OMAwlsfHSeAKnDPWUiDHNRj430oXm5sYKb2ascklMS3_ON8bGOdgR551DpHFFuk9MqIkQVF6f-r93FEBvVdd8Ko1dUF31IvlRT2iWtQrM2U2FiCAPLMtmRCjxubHmW1gbOKWrwxYJGQzOoBHQmkfELdo=&c=bwqbb3RJzMbgruuq0IvyMyXZgFPO4r-YeckeBDI8fs2d4HoJgnIsug==&ch=3gAJxeHzuVnNxI-w_4A8MbxMgY1CHqum44YBkNczartmkc6HQ-BvAg==)
---
| | | [](https://jrhsf9hbb.cc.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=001AIGNOmnSmKnQxOonMI6OMAwlsfHSeAKnDPWUiDHNRj430oXm5sYKb2ascklMS3_ON8bGOdgR551DpHFFuk9MqIkQVF6f-r93FEBvVdd8Ko1dUF31IvlRT2iWtQrM2U2FiCAPLMtmRCjxubHmW1gbOADex6kpj1lzgBX2JrCqWXE=&c=bwqbb3RJzMbgruuq0IvyMyXZgFPO4r-YeckeBDI8fs2d4HoJgnIsug==&ch=3gAJxeHzuVnNxI-w_4A8MbxMgY1CHqum44YBkNczartmkc6HQ-BvAg==)
---
| | Friends,
We need to correct an error in a campaign email sent earlier today.
The email incorrectly stated that a woman involved in the recent Oakland County carjacking was murdered. That was inaccurate.
Fortunately, the victim survived the shooting and is recovering following surgery. We are grateful for that outcome and continue to keep her and her family in our thoughts as she recovers.
We regret the error and apologize for the mistake. Our campaign is committed to providing accurate information, and we wanted to promptly correct the record.
Thank you.
Friends,
Public safety is government's most important responsibility. Prosecutors are elected to protect constitutional rights, enforce the law fairly, and keep our communities safe.
[This week, Oakland County experienced a terrible tragedy. A mother was shot in front of her child by a suspect who had previously been convicted in Washtenaw County and was out on parole at the time of the attack.](https://jrhsf9hbb.cc.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=001AIGNOmnSmKnQxOonMI6OMAwlsfHSeAKnDPWUiDHNRj430oXm5sYKb-AA5YleyUogosIfrVeTbHEcGwv-gQV4MHN24oXLQzn32o_giMvmNA_SL0QdOzLh8kE2OLmsMR5G484-3A8WOi6DIwf6n0IE4bfTqk420Ap-WcQObxK9SAJLau2zqbAvGoEJNyua72YOeUI5eWBP93GauSG-BA3XuvTG0Jgd5g2K-9FiD_2kUouqiP9kSPxnQtLkhxFmtQm-YwSo0SGUazsNrCpgn_zWHsi44fg3FlS45uu5CuaENXS3fWawRAyIRqmnmdsvOl04&c=bwqbb3RJzMbgruuq0IvyMyXZgFPO4r-YeckeBDI8fs2d4HoJgnIsug==&ch=3gAJxeHzuVnNxI-w_4A8MbxMgY1CHqum44YBkNczartmkc6HQ-BvAg==)
Oakland County Sheriff Michael Bouchard responded bluntly: ["These prosecutors need to do their damn job."](https://jrhsf9hbb.cc.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=001AIGNOmnSmKnQxOonMI6OMAwlsfHSeAKnDPWUiDHNRj430oXm5sYKb-AA5YleyUogoIcGX0OxQf-38XhuayTRAWUNbGyocOuVe52VXtVoMkVN5eJaI1DkVoMBUYCIBL3AhPZiy022smvbDZ1Wf-BQdBTkKEXdKipZEL3SrSYQpA8xHC0I8wmrzJtxE5X9OcT3lc8JlyVVbvMFXcnN9Q_Qzg==&c=bwqbb3RJzMbgruuq0IvyMyXZgFPO4r-YeckeBDI8fs2d4HoJgnIsug==&ch=3gAJxeHzuVnNxI-w_4A8MbxMgY1CHqum44YBkNczartmkc6HQ-BvAg==) He is right. When violent offenders are treated with leniency and accountability breaks down, innocent people pay the price.
This tragedy also highlights an important contrast in the race for Attorney General.
My opponent, Washtenaw County Prosecutor Eli Savit, has championed many of the same progressive criminal justice policies that have failed in cities across the country, including efforts to eliminate cash bail and reduce penalties for drug and prostitution offenses. These policies prioritize ideology over public safety and have weakened confidence in the justice system.
I believe prosecutors have a duty to protect victims, uphold truth in sentencing, and hold violent criminals accountable. That is why more than 60 prosecutors across Michigan have endorsed our campaign. They know what is at stake.
Michigan families deserve to feel safe in their communities. They deserve an Attorney General focused on enforcing the law, supporting law enforcement, protecting victims, and keeping dangerous offenders off our streets.
Thanks to your support, our campaign continues to build momentum. [A recent MIRS/Mitchell poll showed us leading 44% to 40%](https://jrhsf9hbb.cc.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=001AIGNOmnSmKnQxOonMI6OMAwlsfHSeAKnDPWUiDHNRj430oXm5sYKb-AA5YleyUogU84FtY0gPIqfcjkJas7XNDHAIUnTS7JGuyFurD8P77jDZ7wu12dUCI8Rgmeix3QD7AaKDFxf8-uD9xmVK3r_ej1E4ENf7-kPCQs-ek1KPmCkqUs6fA0LFd_dX132vfZy-aABT1qNiIlo8R0Ao5Jesrgehtxb6MRAGi6gsRnzJyg=&c=bwqbb3RJzMbgruuq0IvyMyXZgFPO4r-YeckeBDI8fs2d4HoJgnIsug==&ch=3gAJxeHzuVnNxI-w_4A8MbxMgY1CHqum44YBkNczartmkc6HQ-BvAg==), the largest lead held by any Republican in a statewide race. Voters are making clear they want accountability and public safety restored to the Attorney General's office.
[With your help, we can stop dangerous policies from taking hold in Michigan and ensure public safety remains the top priority.](https://jrhsf9hbb.cc.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=001AIGNOmnSmKnQxOonMI6OMAwlsfHSeAKnDPWUiDHNRj430oXm5sYKb2ascklMS3_ODkZWLUH8uM0-wEDaKXt8vxtXOKi3zFg6O2I8wcdfLrs5GeAi1nlT0-KurNM2bROWwnIF1oTnjGZhfYJ5i5odt901svLeEsmprkjsdUrAABlUw-4EOh6msamXz0AhEW-SewOSGweUfQDb6keqaK5XQpa5PssO9IbM&c=bwqbb3RJzMbgruuq0IvyMyXZgFPO4r-YeckeBDI8fs2d4HoJgnIsug==&ch=3gAJxeHzuVnNxI-w_4A8MbxMgY1CHqum44YBkNczartmkc6HQ-BvAg==)
Doug Lloyd Eaton County Prosecuting Attorney Republican Nominee for Michigan Attorney General

clean_body: Oakland County tragedy exposes dangerous policies | | | | | == | | | == | | Friends, We need to correct an error in a campaign email sent earlier today. The email incorrectly stated that a woman involved in the recent Oakland County carjacking was murdered. That was inaccurate. Fortunately, the victim survived the shooting and is recovering following surgery. We are grateful for that outcome and continue to keep her and her family in our thoughts as she recovers. We regret the error and apologize for the mistake. Our campaign is committed to providing accurate information, and we wanted to promptly correct the record. Thank you. Friends, Public safety is government's most important responsibility. Prosecutors are elected to protect constitutional rights, enforce the law fairly, and keep our communities safe. == Oakland County Sheriff Michael Bouchard responded bluntly: == He is right. When violent offenders are treated with leniency and accountability breaks down, innocent people pay the price. This tragedy also highlights an important contrast in the race for Attorney General. My opponent, Washtenaw County Prosecutor Eli Savit, has championed many of the same progressive criminal justice policies that have failed in cities across the country, including efforts to eliminate cash bail and reduce penalties for drug and prostitution offenses. These policies prioritize ideology over public safety and have weakened confidence in the justice system. I believe prosecutors have a duty to protect victims, uphold truth in sentencing, and hold violent criminals accountable. That is why more than 60 prosecutors across Michigan have endorsed our campaign. They know what is at stake. Michigan families deserve to feel safe in their communities. They deserve an Attorney General focused on enforcing the law, supporting law enforcement, protecting victims, and keeping dangerous offenders off our streets. Thanks to your support, our campaign continues to build momentum. ==, the largest lead held by any Republican in a statewide race. body:
Texas Attorney General Ken Paxton [launched an investigation](https://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJykkLGuqzAMhp8mbEGOIUkZMtyFrXc9IzJgaKRAKmKV9u2P6Cuc1Z9s_9__cx_uFFPc1_-0cZD3koedz5JYhI_hSW_Ju9CxspSNhZaU8xz3dUBAp8FqNMNMMX2GtprDCHNnKg7G-65xpm2hegQLBKahsfHGknH-BuinxYzsumaCzlUxXMfAojEGGutrblu0AN3kDLqbuakWeI6Sj1oeLPymsqRPfvFRT3mrUniIPItq_insFfbnedbTWC6LiyvsvysK-2uksL889JqoFC76y3TcX1wkriQx79pqBH1lUthXR5ifZ0wpFudVC-tGMX3_yt_aegX8DQAA__9HQ32N) into Meta's AI-powered smart glasses on Wednesday, saying the devices may be collecting video, audio, and facial data from Texans without consent.

# Thursday, May 21, 2026
---|---
**Good Morning!** On [this day in 1849](https://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJyk0EEOnCAUgOHT4E4DCKgLFt24m267NAhPeSmCgZdx5vZNe4Ve4P-T79drezlMmM-f7gJLn6NsGZ6WgAjqdrsPlUyunkDtAnJHKiVgPjfJpem57qXYgsP03VQX7M7DIjqwYpqW0QileBet9rNWuw7gDg6wm9mPfDG78UaPcpKhQ_s3xrUUQvBRTwMoJTXnizdCmlnMTHEISKUOFIHg49qRvuUNdfDl6pKNRHdj4w8mVybX53kGatGVnDDDUOrJ5BpdDnspv5lcIVNFaEyujQBzdCfk3seKjcodofZHRQhQ0cfeu5q6asP9YErYzMQUPy-H6d-Z_s_rbeWfAAAA__9MnYHK), German immigrant and famed cabinetmaker Charles Steinhagen arrived in Galveston. Many of his pieces were collected by philanthropist Ima Hogg and later donated to the University of Texas. Three friends from Argentina have spent nearly a year [biking roughly 10,000 miles](https://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJyk0LHSqyAQBeCnwQ4HNoBaUNzGLre9pUNgVSYIDu6Nydv_Y17hb3dnzpzv_LtPdxdTzMtft6Gl91ymjOeRkAjrtLs3lUyuLkjHhuTmVEqIeZlAgOFCc5BTcDF9JtUE-xBhkA1a2XXDzUilRLNaZYKW6IObjTcwSAiz74PuvRk8DCibaK8woUFKKW66a1Ep0EIM3kgwveyZEhgildrSioRvd8zpU15YW1-2JtmVaD_Y7Q-DkcF4nmebHz7M5_VmMF4eBmMq3iUG44XJFDNyqrHwR3zGvHApnnyLCQ_-lZ2lpsD9_50fVHY-l0rXjVYGoxKgYdAMxqbasJ8xpXiYjimxbC6mbyn63ZQvCz8BAAD__9MSh90) through 17 countries on their way to this summer's FIFA World Cup, and they just made a memorable stop in North Texas. See _Et Cetera_ for the details. Could a single phone call or email wipe out a lifetime of savings in your family? ## Paxton Targets Meta Over Smart Glasses
Texas Attorney General Ken Paxton [launched an investigation](https://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJykkLGuqzAMhp8mbEGOIUkZMtyFrXc9IzJgaKRAKmKV9u2P6Cuc1Z9s_9__cx_uFFPc1_-0cZD3koedz5JYhI_hSW_Ju9CxspSNhZaU8xz3dUBAp8FqNMNMMX2GtprDCHNnKg7G-65xpm2hegQLBKahsfHGknH-BuinxYzsumaCzlUxXMfAojEGGutrblu0AN3kDLqbuakWeI6Sj1oeLPymsqRPfvFRT3mrUniIPItq_insFfbnedbTWC6LiyvsvysK-2uksL889JqoFC76y3TcX1wkriQx79pqBH1lUthXR5ifZ0wpFudVC-tGMX3_yt_aegX8DQAA__9HQ32N) into Meta's AI-powered smart glasses on Wednesday, saying the devices may be collecting video, audio, and facial data from Texans without consent. His office also cited reports that [data annotators at Sama](https://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJyk0bHOnDAMwPGngc2nxAkBBoYubF_XjsgQHxddSE7Ehbu3r_iqPkEnD5b-1k_-9TV9UYghrT9p40He9zwlPktkEd6nF70lJ6F9ZSkbC91jzj6kdUKFDlQDqCdPIX4mW_thVr7XNQ-6bXvjtLWqfgxmsR5bVoq7BU3boWPTaeS-U2ampqnDcMVUg1prZZr2xtZio1S_OI2u011lFfsgeb_Jg4XfVO7xkw_eb0ve6jg8RF6lMj8qHCscz_O8PR_597WscDyC51zheKkqHGNeKFY4fmf-TaAVnpzgLxdCOrhIWElCWuFiw3UNXns4aPnAktPCeyoQQ3qyB8lQNtoF1kil8JXFrgFCQ84oDbMjBtvOCmZWCEzaNa6dqSeq98G_zhBjKK6trFo3CvGbJf_3jGPAPwEAAP__AkyeFw), a Meta subcontractor, accessed private footage--including intimate moments. | | _Formerly All On The Line_ |
---|---|---

Peter,
All across the South, we are witnessing a stunning return to an ugly era most of us believed we’d left behind. Lawmakers are moving at break-neck speed to take voting power away from racial minorities.
Mere hours after the Supreme Court gutted key protections of the Voting Rights Act, politicians in several southern states were putting plans into motion. They see the ruling as a green light to grab power by eliminating districts where voters of color have had the opportunity to elect candidates of their choice.
Take a look at what Tennessee has done.
The map they passed just eight days after the Supreme Court decision erased the state’s only Black opportunity district — breaking up the city of Memphis into three districts.
Peter, I never want to see our country go back to the days of Jim Crow. I believe that the American people are with me on that. And everyone can see what’s happening.
This behavior is outrageous. If you’re outraged, President Obama and I need you with us to be part of the grassroots effort fighting back. clean_body: I never want to see our country go back to the days of Jim Crow. I believe that the American people are with me on that. | | | Formerly All On The Line | ---|---|--- Peter, All across the South, we are witnessing a stunning return to an ugly era most of us believed we’d left behind. Lawmakers are moving at break-neck speed to take voting power away from racial minorities. Mere hours after the Supreme Court gutted key protections of the Voting Rights Act, politicians in several southern states were putting plans into motion. They see the ruling as a green light to grab power by eliminating districts where voters of color have had the opportunity to elect candidates of their choice. Take a look at what Tennessee has done. The map they passed just eight days after the Supreme Court decision erased the state’s only Black opportunity district — breaking up the city of Memphis into three districts. Peter, I never want to see our country go back to the days of Jim Crow. I believe that the American people are with me on that. And everyone can see what’s happening. This behavior is outrageous. subject: Hurd Volunteer Training
body:
Hi,

My name is Sidney, and I work on Jeff Hurd's Congressional Campaign. I
noted that you are interested in hearing information about the Campaign.
Thank you for your interest in getting involved with the campaign.

We’re hosting a volunteer training event tomorrow at 5:30 PM, and we’d love
for you to join us. This will be a great chance to meet the team, learn how
you can help with door knocking, calling constituents, and get plugged into
upcoming volunteer opportunities.

Please feel free to bring a friend who might be interested.

Attached are the details. Looking forward to seeing you there!

Best,

Sidney

name: Christina Hines
subject: There's less than 80 days until the primary
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Christina for Congress
body:
https://secure.actblue.com/donate/upl_cbh_email-26q2?refcode=x_260521_KeepGoing_actrs [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/upl_cbh_email-26q2?refcode=x_260521_KeepGoing_actrs]
We launched our campaign for Congress with a belief that our community deserves better and a scrappiness that’s unique to Michigan’s 10th. I knew this journey would require sacrifice, and I also knew it would come with incredible moments. I want to share my favorite part of this experience with you:
It’s the conversations that stay with you.
Sometimes those conversations are hard. Seniors worried about rising grocery costs and threats to Social Security. Working parents doing everything they can to stay afloat while giving their kids the best life possible. A neighbor quietly sharing concerns about her mother’s recent cancer diagnosis.
Sometimes those conversations are full of joy: “I’ve never actually had a politician knock on my door before!” “My daughter is starting at Michigan in the fall!” “DEEETROIT BASKETBALL!”
These moments are my favorite part of this race because they remind me why this campaign matters. At the end of the day, people want to know that someone in Washington is listening and willing to fight for them. These conversations also remind me that even in difficult times, we can still build something better together for our families, our communities, and our future.

Joining Steve is Congresswoman Harriet Hageman who represents the state of Wyoming in the U.S. House of Representatives. She grew up on a ranch, attended Casper College on a livestock judging scholarship and earned both her bachelor's degree and law degree from the University of Wyoming. A litigator for 34 years, Harriet is nationally known for challenging federal overreach, for protecting water and property rights, for exposing federal land and wildlife mismanagement, and for fighting back against the unconstitutional and unlawful acts of unelected bureaucrats. Harriet has extensive experience engaging in complex trials against federal agencies and has been admitted to practice in several states as well as the United States Supreme Court.

Recently she challenged congress on the way Abortion demonstrators were treated under the Biden Administration. Harriet has spearheaded the fight against climate activism being used as a means of preventing further exploration and development of coal, oil and natural gas resources. For more about her work visit

| | Lifе and death Son of Mykhailo Sulyma, Ivan came from a petty noble (szlachta) family. He was born in Rohoshchi (next to Chernihiv). He served as an estate overseer for Stanisław Żółkiewski and later the family of Daniłowicze who inherited his lands; for that service in 1620 he was awarded three villages: Sulimówka, Kuczakiw and Lebedyn. Аll the villages todаy belong to the Boryspil Raion, Kyiv Oblast. His sons included Stepan (died 1659), a captain of Boryspil company, and Fedir (died 1691), a colonel of Pereiaslav regiment. He became popular among the unregistered Cossacks, leading them on campaigns to plunder Crimea and other Ottoman vassal territories. For organizing a revolt on an Ottoman slave galley and freeing Christian slaves[1] he received a medal from Pope Paul V himself. Eventually, Sulyma reached the rank of the hetman, which he held from 1628 to 1629 and 1630 to 1635. In 1635, after returning from an expedition to Black Sea against the Ottomans, he decided to rebel against the Polish–Lithuanian Commonwealth, which at that time controlled most of the Cossack territories, and whose nobility was trying to turn militant Cossacks into serfs.[citation needed] Ivan Sulyma took part in numerous campaigns of Sagaidachny against Tatars and Turks. In particular, it was the famous capture of Kafa (modern Theodosia), the main center of the slave trade on the Black Sea, Trapezont, Izmail, and also two attacks on Tsaregrad. Hieroglyphs combined logographic, syllabic and alphabetic elements, with some 1,000 distinct characters.[3][4] Cursive hieroglyphs were used for religious literature on papyrus and wood. Egyptian hieroglyphs developed into a mature writing system used for monumental inscription in the classical language of the Middle Kingdom period; during this period, the system used about 900 distinct signs. Late survivals of hieroglyphic use are found well into the Roman period, extending into the 4th century AD.[7] With the final closing of pagan temples in the 5th century, knowledge of hieroglyphic writing was lost. The glyphs themselves, since the Ptolemaic period, were called τὰ ἱερογλυφικὰ [γράμματα] (tà hieroglyphikà [grámmata]) "the sacred engraved letters", the Greek counterpart to the Egyptian expression of mdw.w-nṯr "god's words".[14] Greek ἱερόγλυφος meant "a carver of hieroglyphs".[15] In English, hieroglyph as a noun is recorded from 1590, originally short for nominalized hieroglyphic (1580s, with a plural hieroglyphics), from adjectival use (hieroglyphic character).[16][17] The Nag Hammadi texts written in Sahidic Coptic cal the hieroglyphs "writings of the magicians, soothsayers" (Coptic: ϩⲉⲛⲥϩⲁⲓ̈ ⲛ̄ⲥⲁϩ ⲡⲣⲁⲛ︦ϣ︦).[18] | | | | | | You could be losing money every swipe thanks to high interest But these cards flip the script: 0% APR intro period on purchases and balance transfers. body:
It's a Chinese Company that manufactures electric and hybrid cars, and I am working to ban them from entering U.S. markets.
# [](https://act.elissaslotkin.org/go/188?t=1&akid=2455%2E135344%2Eoz1jym)

**BYD.**
Heard of it?
It's a Chinese Company that manufactures electric and hybrid cars, and I am working to ban them from entering U.S. markets.
I want you to understand this issue. Because it's both an economic and real national security issue.
On the economy, as Michigan’s U.S. Senator, I have a special responsibility to protect the nearly 1 million people in my state whose livelihoods are connected to the domestic auto industry. The Chinese Communist Party has a playbook where they steal intellectual property, heavily subsidize products, flood the market, and undercut American manufacturers. I cannot let that happen to Michigan’s auto industry.
From a national security perspective, these vehicles are like TikTok on wheels. They take full motion video, they do 3D mapping and more. And I just cannot accept all that data in and around our military bases and sensitive infrastructure sites and more being sent back to Beijing.
**[Here's a video I recorded on the subject.](https://act.elissaslotkin.org/go/4369?t=2&akid=2455%2E135344%2Eoz1jym)**
[](https://act.elissaslotkin.org/go/4369?t=3&akid=2455%2E135344%2Eoz1jym)
**[And here's a news article.](https://act.elissaslotkin.org/go/4370?t=4&akid=2455%2E135344%2Eoz1jym)**
Thanks for reading,
Elissa Slotkin

As one of the few Senators who won a Senate race in the same state won by Trump, Elissa Slotkin is being asked to campaign for other Democrats in tough races across the country this election.

The outcome of this election will determine whether we are able to put a check on President Trump during the final two years of his term. We have to take back the House and the Senate. And we need your help to get it done.

body:

Ken Burns here, friend. I’ve said this before and it’s now more relevant than ever: The power rests in our hands to secure the future of the Senate.
**_[I have more to say, but if you want to use that power in your own hands, and have a few bucks to spare, please consider donating to Roy Cooper’s campaign today. Winning his race is absolutely critical if we’re going to flip the Senate, so I hope you’ll join me.](https://act.roycooper.com/go/11746?t=8&akid=1489%2E124072%2E9uMNCZ)_**
Across this country, people are feeling the strain in ways that don’t always make the history books – but shape lives all the same. The cost of groceries that are too high. A lifesaving prescription that forces a difficult choice. A paycheck that doesn’t just stretch as far as it once did.
These are the quiet pressures that define a moment.

Roy Cooper has spent much of his life as a public servant working to ease those burdens.
Not seeking attention, but doing the work. Expanding access to affordable health care. Investing in public schools. Defending the idea that government, at its best, is not distant – but present, steady and accountable to the people it serves.
It is the kind of leadership that rarely makes noise. But over time, it leaves a mark.

There are those who would take the state in a different direction – who see division as a strategy, who mistake power for purpose. They are organized. They are well-funded by dark-money groups.
**_[We can beat them back. This work matters, and we won’t stop fighting. So please, will you chip in now to help elect Roy Cooper for the U.S. Senate?](https://act.roycooper.com/go/11746?t=9&akid=1489%2E124072%2E9uMNCZ)_**
| | [DONATE $5](https://act.roycooper.com/go/11747?amount=5&t=10&akid=1489%2E124072%2E9uMNCZ)
---
History has been written in moments like this – when people choose not to sit back, but to take part.
If you can, _[**give today**](https://act.roycooper.com/go/11746?t=11&akid=1489%2E124072%2E9uMNCZ)_. Help ensure that the next chapter of North Carolina reflects the very best of what this state has always tried to be.
Thank you for doing your part,

Ken Burns

Cooper is a former state legislator, Attorney General, and most recently Governor of North Carolina. North Carolina will be the most competitive Senate election of 2026, and Cooper enters the race as the most formidable candidate of either party.

Cooper’s signature achievements include helping to expand Medicaid and helping make NC the top state for business by creating thousands of jobs and growing the clean energy economy.

body:

# Why Conservative Oklahoma Needs Todd Russ Back as Treasurer
---
|
---
| | Dear Conservative Friend,
As a lifelong Oklahoman and proud conservative, I have delivered real results for our state without raising taxes.
I’ve spent more than 30 years in the private sector in banking. I have a degree in finance from Southwestern Oklahoma State University with an emphasis in international finance, as well as a graduate degree in bank management from the University of Colorado School of Banking. I’m also the only candidate in this race with a Certificate in Public Finance Administration from Pepperdine University.
I am well prepared to continue leading the Treasury and continue breaking record after record. When I came into the Treasury, the state’s $18 billion portfolio generated $80 million for the General Revenue Fund. Two years ago, I generated $450 million for that fund, and I’m on track to exceed $470 million this year because I understand how to make money and hold people accountable.
That’s conservative stewardship at its best, protecting your tax dollars and growing Oklahoma’s reserves while other states struggle with big-spending politicians.
I also moved nearly $1 billion in state deposits into Oklahoma community banks instead of Wall Street. I’m one of you, rooted in rural values. I’m a former banker and State Representative with a 100% pro-life and pro-Second Amendment record.

**Todd Russ**

**Vote for Todd Russ on June 16**

name: Deb Haaland
subject: I can't do this without you
disclaimer_text: PAID FOR AND AUTHORIZED BY DEB FOR NEW MEXICO**
body:
Add your name in support of my vision for New Mexico!

| | | [](https://act.debhaaland.com/go/134?t=1&akid=9726%2E400544%2EXMgKHe)
---
Friend: In a moment, I'm going to share with you my vision for New Mexico — **_[but first, can I ask you to take 30 seconds to personally endorse my campaign for Governor?](https://act.debhaaland.com/signup/em_mw_202605_endorse_vision?email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=&ask=5&source=jtk736-su-nd&refcode=jtk736-su-nd&t=2&akid=9726%2E400544%2EXMgKHe)_**
| | [Add My Name](https://act.debhaaland.com/signup/em_mw_202605_endorse_vision?email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=&ask=5&source=jtk736-su-nd&refcode=jtk736-su-nd&t=3&akid=9726%2E400544%2EXMgKHe)
---
This message is a bit on the longer side, but because you're invested in the future of New Mexico, I hope you'll take the time to read my plan. **As New Mexico’s next Governor, I will:**
**Build Education That Works for New Mexico by:**
* Ensuring students can read before third grade by identifying literacy challenges early and providing targeted support when children fall behind

* Strengthening early literacy screening, expanding bilingual and reading instruction, and investing in summer reading and after-school programs that reinforce learning beyond the school day

* Bolstering access to universal childcare, because learning begins long before a child enters a classroom

* Directing unspent dollars from the Public School Capital Outlay Fund to modernize and improve school facilities so kids can focus on learning

* Expanding outdoor and place-based learning through my Every Child Outdoor Initiative, giving schools the tools and resources to connect classroom instruction to real-world learning that improves engagement and outcomes

**Support New Mexico Families by:**
* Raising the minimum wage and eliminating predatory junk fees

* Passing Paid Family and Medical Leave so people don’t have to choose between caring for their family and making ends meet

* Increasing the child tax credit to put money back into your pockets

* Creating a statewide tenant bill of rights to make renting more affordable and more transparent

* Creating a Critical Sector Housing Fund for workers in critical sectors — like healthcare, behavioral health, social work, education, and more — to recruit more professionals to New Mexico to address endemic shortages that hold our people back

* Aggressively building more housing, eliminating unnecessary red tape, driving state investment into housing, and shortening the time it takes to build a home — and ensuring those homes are built with New Mexican labor

**Back Small Businesses by:**
* Establishing a permanent Office of Small Business to coordinate development programs, fill gaps left by federal cuts, and provide clear access to grants, capital, and state resources

* Cracking down on predatory lending by requiring full transparency in small-business loan disclosures

* Establishing a New Mexico Economic Growth Trust Fund to stabilize our economy in the face of federal uncertainty

**Fix Our Broken Healthcare System by:**
* Protecting and expanding access to healthcare in every part of New Mexico

* Banning medical debt from being included on credit reports

* Expanding New Mexico’s Health Care Affordability Fund to protect access for those who rely on the state marketplace

* Using budget surpluses to fill Medicaid gaps and hire more guides to help people enroll in and keep their benefits

* Ensuring sustainable funding for rural hospitals and clinics, expanding mobile health clinics, and significantly increasing access to outpatient behavioral and mental health care, including a full-scale effort to deliver mental health and homelessness assistance statewide

**Strengthen Public Safety by:**
* Ensuring that law enforcement has the tools, staffing, and technology they need to do their jobs effectively

* Investing in mental and behavioral healthcare, substance use treatment, rehabilitation, and housing stability

* Expanding violence intervention and prevention programs in schools and communities, building accountability systems that emphasize fairness and trust, and investing in community policing models that supplement traditional police work

* Creating a statewide Department of Community Safety staffed with social workers and counselors so law enforcement can focus on violent crime while people get the help they need

* Requiring ICE agents to clearly identify themselves and prohibiting masks that shield misconduct from accountability

New Mexico deserves steady leadership that’s ready on day one, leadership rooted in firsthand knowledge and experience. But the only way we'll be able to make this vision a reality is with strong grassroots support from people like you.
**I'm aiming to get 5,000 endorsements for my campaign before my midnight deadline to show the grassroots strength behind my vision for New Mexico, and I want you to be one of them._[Will you please take a quick moment to sign on now?](https://act.debhaaland.com/signup/em_mw_202605_endorse_vision?email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=&ask=5&source=jtk736-su-nd&refcode=jtk736-su-nd&t=4&akid=9726%2E400544%2EXMgKHe)_**
| | [Add My Name](https://act.debhaaland.com/signup/em_mw_202605_endorse_vision?email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=&ask=5&source=jtk736-su-nd&refcode=jtk736-su-nd&t=5&akid=9726%2E400544%2EXMgKHe)
---
Thank you for your support,

Deb
|

subject: Fundamental rights should not depend on geography
disclaimer_text: PAID FOR BY CHRISTINA BOHANNAN FOR CONGRESS
body:
| [](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/131822282/622427599/-975735282?refcode=em_logoheader&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTIvMS85MjIyOCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJhODlkOTQ4OS0yMTU1LWYxMTEtOGZjYi0wMDBkM2ExODkwNWMiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=l6luc3YGb20n8Z-NtSk-O5RLoR1sGxkzbwaCNCIW0YY=)

Peter,

Today marks 107 years since the House passed the 19th Amendment, the constitutional amendment that, once ratified, would finally guarantee women across the country the right to vote. When we look back on the women's suffrage movement, it can sometimes feel like history moved all at once. _But that's not how it happened._

Before the 19th Amendment, some states allowed women to vote, while many others did not. Rights depended on geography. In one state, a woman could participate in democracy. **Across a border, she could be completely shut out of it. Our country was a patchwork of haves and have-nots.**

The women who came before us saw that injustice clearly, and they refused to accept it. They organized, protested, lobbied lawmakers, and demanded that women in every state be recognized as equal participants in American democracy. And even after the 19th Amendment was ratified, women of color still faced barriers that kept them from exercising that right until the Voting Rights Act of 1965.

As a lawyer, I think a lot about what these fights say about our country and about the law itself. **Rights are never secure if they only belong to some people in some places. Equality under the law cannot depend on your sex or zip code.**

Once again, we are living in a country where fundamental rights depend on geography. In some states, women can have a conversation about their options with their doctor. In others, politicians have stepped in to ban abortion and criminalize reproductive health.

But it doesn't have to be this way, Peter. We've seen it before. When women come together in solidarity, we change this country.

The 19th Amendment stands as proof of that. Progress has always required ordinary people deciding they would no longer accept injustice as inevitable. I believe voting rights and bodily autonomy are part of the right to self-determination.

**[That's why I will always be committed to protecting reproductive freedom, including the right to abortion. In Congress, I will fight to restore the protections of _Roe v. Wade_ and ensure that women are trusted to make their own healthcare decisions. Five years ago, in the early hours of January 6th, 2021 — right before the President's mob sacked the Capitol — hope broke out across the nation because the people of Georgia had spoken so clearly.

body:
Even Senator John Fetterman — a Democrat — admits his own party caused "mass chaos." When Democrats themselves are sounding the alarm, every patriot needs to pay attention.

| | | | [](https://trk.email.tedcruz._dXRtX3NvdXJjZT1FLUhvdXNlRmlsZSZ1dG1fY2FtcGFpZ249Q3J1el9NYXktRmV0dGVybWFuXzIwMjYwNTE5JnV0bV9tZWRpdW09RW1haWwmdXRtX2NvbnRlbnQ9TWF5LUZldHRlcm1hbiZ1dG1fYWdlbmN5PVBHJmFtb3VudD0xMjUifQ/anM8h94C_ElvRcL28s-QPg)

| | | Fellow Conservative, I've served in the United States Senate long enough to know that senators rarely break ranks with their own party in public. So when Senator John Fetterman, a Democrat from Pennsylvania, told _The Hill_ something this striking about his own caucus, I knew I had to share it with you immediately. Here's exactly what Sen. Fetterman said: _"I've, you know, had to vote against the caucus. I don't enjoy that, but we used to be a party that would always refuse to shut the government down, and now we have shut it down and dropped a lot of mass chaos, and I just couldn't be a part of that."_ Let that sink in, Fellow Conservative. **"Mass chaos."** Those aren't the words of a Republican. Those aren't my words. Those are the words of a sitting Democrat senator describing what his own party has become. When even members of the Democratic Party are crying foul -- when they can no longer stomach what the radical left is doing to this country -- that's not a partisan talking point. That's a five-alarm fire. [**< <STAND WITH CONSERVATIVES>>**](https://trk.email.tedcruz._dXRtX3NvdXJjZT1FLUhvdXNlRmlsZSZ1dG1fY2FtcGFpZ249Q3J1el9NYXktRmV0dGVybWFuXzIwMjYwNTE5JnV0bV9tZWRpdW09RW1haWwmdXRtX2NvbnRlbnQ9TWF5LUZldHRlcm1hbiZ1dG1fYWdlbmN5PVBHJmFtb3VudD0xMjUifQ/T5lDlNKhDa6X7oTQ3h1dkg) I've watched this Democratic Party transform before my eyes. The party of John F. Kennedy is gone. In its place is a party that:
* **Shuts down the federal government** and brags about it
* **Protects illegal immigrants** while attacking ICE agents doing their jobs
* **Defunds the police** and looks the other way while our cities suffer
* **Tolerates massive fraud** in welfare and Medicaid programs
* **Embraces a pro-Hamas wing** that rejects everything America stands for

Senator Fetterman saw it. He couldn't be a part of it. And he said so on the record. But here's the hard truth: one Democrat senator speaking out isn't enough. We need to elect more Republicans to the United States Senate -- fighters who will stand up to the radicals, restore sanity to Washington, and defend the principles our Founders gave us nearly 250 years ago. That's where you come in... **Will you chip in $10, $25, $50 -- or whatever you can spare today -- to help us elect conservative fighters to the U.S. Senate?** [**< <DONATE NOW>>**](https://trk.email.tedcruz._dXRtX3NvdXJjZT1FLUhvdXNlRmlsZSZ1dG1fY2FtcGFpZ249Q3J1el9NYXktRmV0dGVybWFuXzIwMjYwNTE5JnV0bV9tZWRpdW09RW1haWwmdXRtX2NvbnRlbnQ9TWF5LUZldHRlcm1hbiZ1dG1fYWdlbmN5PVBHJmFtb3VudD0xMjUifQ/bVlhqdYrGG3OUDqH8B5WGw) I'm not going to sugarcoat it. The 2026 map is tough. Democrats are pouring tens of millions of dollars into flipping seats and expanding their majority -- the same Democrats who, in John Fetterman's own words, have unleashed "mass chaos" on this country. **We cannot let them win.** Every dollar you contribute today goes directly toward electing the conservative champions we need -- patriots who will secure our borders, back our police, root out fraud, and put America First. As we approach our nation's 250th birthday, the choice could not be clearer. Stand with the chaos -- or stand with the Constitution. I know where you stand. And I'm grateful to have you in this fight. God bless you, and God bless the United States of America. Sincerely, Ted Cruz United States Senator P.S. -- When a Democrat senator publicly admits his own party caused "mass chaos," you know we are at a turning point. Please don't wait. **[Chip in $10, $25, or $50 right now to help us elect more conservative fighters in 2026.](https://trk.email.tedcruz._dXRtX3NvdXJjZT1FLUhvdXNlRmlsZSZ1dG1fY2FtcGFpZ249Q3J1el9NYXktRmV0dGVybWFuXzIwMjYwNTE5JnV0bV9tZWRpdW09RW1haWwmdXRtX2NvbnRlbnQ9TWF5LUZldHRlcm1hbiZ1dG1fYWdlbmN5PVBHJmFtb3VudD0xMjUifQ/lrfSYdYRQSQXp40XNWQ0yg)** Thank you.

subject: What does the Appropriations Committee actually do?
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Veronica Escobar for Congress
body:
A quick explanation of one of the most influential committees in Congress.
| | [](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/131825341/622435010/-1405467182?nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMDEvMS82MTY0NSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJjMjY2ODViYy0yNTU1LWYxMTEtOGZjYi0wMDBkM2ExODkwNWMiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=gzvodn1lpPPeYOslV_j4MgonX9R7XYoppbFCsBTolo4=&emci=2681cc15-8954-f111-8fcb-000d3a18905c&emdi=c26685bc-2555-f111-8fcb-000d3a18905c&ceid=14565883)
---

| | Welcome back to Fact Check Friday... one day early. With the holiday weekend ahead, I wanted to get this week's edition to you a little sooner. **Today, we're discussing the House Appropriations Committee and why serving on it matters so much for our community.** I've realized that when people hear the word "appropriations," it sounds like typical Washington jargon — important, sure, but it goes in one ear and out the other. So let's break down what the committee actually does and why it hits so close to home. At its core, the Appropriations Committee is responsible for deciding how your taxpayer dollars are allocated across the government. It crafts legislation that determines funding for federal agencies, programs, and operations that affect millions of Americans every day. Think of it this way: Congress can pass all the laws it wants, but without this committee, those laws don't have a single dollar behind them to get the work done. We turn legislative priorities into actual action. But the work goes beyond simply deciding where money goes. A massive part of our job is oversight and accountability. We review agency budgets, hear testimony from administration officials and experts, ask tough questions, and hold agencies accountable for how taxpayer dollars are being spent. We look for gaps, identify inefficiencies, and push to ensure communities receive the support they deserve. I see this firsthand through my assignments on the Homeland Security Subcommittee and the Military Construction, Veterans Affairs, and Related Agencies Subcommittee. Those roles allow me to advocate for issues that directly affect our border community and the people who call it home. I'm honored to serve on the Appropriations Committee because it allows me to be a voice for El Paso in some of the biggest decisions being made in Washington. Too often, decisions are made for border communities without people at the table who understand what our communities actually need. At the end of the day, this work is about ensuring federal investments reach the people and communities they're meant to serve, and that El Paso isn't overlooked in the process. If you want to keep getting clear, fact-based breakdowns of the issues affecting our community, make sure you stay connected and share this with someone who should be paying attention, too. clean_body: A quick explanation of one of the most influential committees in Congress. | | | | Welcome back to Fact Check Friday... one day early. With the holiday weekend ahead, I wanted to get this week's edition to you a little sooner. Today, we're discussing the House Appropriations Committee and why serving on it matters so much for our community. I've realized that when people hear the word "appropriations," it sounds like typical Washington jargon — important, sure, but it goes in one ear and out the other. So let's break down what the committee actually does and why it hits so close to home. At its core, the Appropriations Committee is responsible for deciding how your taxpayer dollars are allocated across the government. It crafts legislation that determines funding for federal agencies, programs, and operations that affect millions of Americans every day. Think of it this way: Congress can pass all the laws it wants, but without this committee, those laws don't have a single dollar behind them to get the work done. We turn legislative priorities into actual action. But the work goes beyond simply deciding where money goes. A massive part of our job is oversight and accountability. We review agency budgets, hear testimony from administration officials and experts, ask tough questions, and hold agencies accountable for how taxpayer dollars are being spent. We look for gaps, identify inefficiencies, and push to ensure communities receive the support they deserve. I see this firsthand through my assignments on the Homeland Security Subcommittee and the Military Construction, Veterans Affairs, and Related Agencies Subcommittee. Those roles allow me to advocate for issues that directly affect our border community and the people who call it home. I'm honored to serve on the Appropriations Committee because it allows me to be a voice for El Paso in some of the biggest decisions being made in Washington. Too often, decisions are made for border communities without people at the table who understand what our communities actually need. At the end of the day, this work is about ensuring federal investments reach the people and communities they're meant to serve, and that El Paso isn't overlooked in the process. If you want to keep getting clear, fact-based breakdowns of the issues affecting our community, make sure you stay connected and share this with someone who should be paying attention, too. Staying informed is power. Let's use it, El Paso.
